<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, shrink-to-fit=no">
    <title>service unavailable</title>
    <meta name="description" content="no server is available to handle the request">
    <style>
        body, html {
            padding: 0;
            margin: 0;
            background: #fff;
            font-size: 16px;
            height: 100%;
            min-height: 100%;
            font-family: sans-serif;
            color: #26405f;
        }

        a, a:visited {
            color: #0f87ed;
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        a:hover {
            color: #0f87eb;
            text-decoration: underline;
        }

        p {
            border-top: 1px solid slategray;
            display: inline-block;
            padding-top: 10px;
        }

        .logo {
            margin: 20px;
            max-width: 200px;
            min-width: 120px;
            display: block;
            margin-left: auto;
        }

        h1 {
            font-size: 48px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        h1 span {
            font-size: 20px;
            display: block;
        }
        .requestid {
            color: #999bac;
        }

        @media (min-width: 420px) {
            .t {
                display: table;
                max-width: 720px;
                height: 100%;
                margin: 0 auto;
            }

            .t-inner {
                display: table;
                width: 100%;
            }

            .t-cell {
                display: table-cell;
                vertical-align: middle;
                padding: 20px;
            }

            .t-cell.right {
                border-left: 4px solid #26405f;
            }

            .t-cell.left {
                border-right: 4px solid #26405f;
                padding-right: 0;
            }

            p {
                margin: 0 0 20px;
                padding-right: 20px;
            }
        }

        .t-mob {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }

        @media (max-width: 419px) {
            .t-mob {
                display: table;
                width: 100%;
                height: 100%;
            }

            .t-mob .t {
                display: table-cell;
                vertical-align: middle;
                padding: 20px;
            }

            .t-cell.right {
                text-align: right;
                padding-right: 25px;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="t-mob">
    <div class="t">
        <div class="t-cell">
            <div class="t-inner">
                <div class="t-cell left">
                    <img class="logo loader" src="data:image/png;base64,"/>
                </div>
                <div class="t-cell right">
                    <h1>
                        503
                        <span>service unavailable</span>
                    </h1>
                    <p>
                        no server is available to handle the request
                        <br/>
                        <small>this can be a sign that the origin servers are having issues</small>
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</body>
</html>
